Description
Immerse yourself in the modern elegance of this furnished two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo, spanning 1,012 square feet of beautifully appointed living space in the desirable Kitsilano neighborhood of Vancouver. The home features a dedicated office area, perfect for today's remote professionals and students seeking a quiet corner to focus and achieve. The 'May Be Considered' pet policy adds to the appeal, potentially welcoming your furry companions into this stylish space. Located in a dynamic area, the residence is a stone's throw away from an array of dining experiences, chic boutiques, engaging recreational spots, and the serene beaches that define the Kitsilano lifestyle.

Description
Bannister Mews is one of the most distinguished townhome developments in Kerrisdale in recent years. Located at Arbutus and W.49th built within a retained and restored historic stone wall, this project combines architectural cues that exemplify characters of this historic neighbourhood with modern luxurious interior design. This 1,271sf, 3 levels, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms townhouse features hardwood and engineered laminate floors throughout. Up the foyer to the main living area is the huge rectangular living room, dining area with ceiling fan and kitchen. The gourmet kitchen comes with shaker wood cabinetry, granite countertop, stainless steel Bosch and Fisher & Paykel appliances. Note: no more than two unrelated occupants are allowed for insurance restrictions reasons.
